'''Maheyya''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]]. Posted on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], she send a team of her people into the jungle to search for artifacts, only to lose contact with them. She then asked another Imperial to recover both the artifacts and the signs of her lost expedition.<ref name="TOR" />
